address: 10488 Valley View St., Buena Park, 90620, USA
bio: This unassuming spot in an easy-to-miss location in an open-air mall belies the wondrous steaming bowls found within. The small dining room with space for 20 is strictly no frills but it's of no concern, since you're here for the soul-stirring comfort food made with passion and dedication. The concise menu features a few appetizers, though ramen clearly steals the show. Spicy red miso ramen is rich and creamy, radiates flavor and bobs with springy noodles, while savory chicken ramen is lighter but equally delicious. White miso, tonkotsu ramen and tsukemen (dipping noodles) are also worthwhile choices. Quite simply, these bowls will inspire future visits. Pork buns round out the utterly satisfying experience....
